## Change

Describe what changed and the behavior it improves.

## Verification

Give the commands you ran and the result. For changes to metadata, save behavior or file formats, include a small synthetic example and the relevant privacy or pixel-integrity check.

For website or documentation changes, include the Pages build, manifest verification, and Wiki build results and the reader paths you checked. Include keyboard and viewport results if you changed navigation or layout.

## Tradeoffs

Call out compatibility, accessibility, new dependencies, or any limits reviewers should know.
